# API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.mjs (pnpm docs:api) from the method registry of @better-compute/server and PLAN.md §9.2. Do not edit by hand. -->

@better-compute/server 0.1.0 serves `POST /api/compute/{group}/{method}`.

## Calling the API

- `POST {basePath}/{group}/{method}`, and `POST {basePath}/plugins/{id}/{group}/{method}` for plugins. The default base path is `/api/compute`.
- Requests need `content-type: application/json` and `X-Better-Compute: 1`, or they are refused with `CSRF_REJECTED`. The body is a JSON object of at most 64 KiB.
- Credentials: an IAM bearer token, or a session JWT whose audience includes compute. The IAM session cookie counts only when the server sets `acceptIamCookie`, and then only from the server's exact origin.
- Answers: `{ "data": … }`, or `{ "error": { "code", "message", "retryAfterMs"?, "details"? } }` with the status below. A valid `X-Request-Id` is echoed; otherwise the server assigns one.
- The only GET routes are `{basePath}/health` and `{basePath}/.well-known/better-compute`.
- Typed client: `createComputeClient<typeof compute>({ baseURL, token })` from `@better-compute/client`.

## Methods

Every call is authenticated (except public methods), refused before any database access when the caller is outside the input tenant and the root tenant, and decided once on `action @ resource`. _+ items_ marks the list recipe. **Registered** methods are routed by this build; a registered stub answers `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming its phase. **Planned** methods arrive in the phase shown.

## Errors

| Code                    | HTTP status |
| ----------------------- | ----------- |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED`       | 401         |
| `ACCESS_DENIED`         | 403         |
| `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` | 403         |
| `NOT_FOUND`             | 404         |
| `INVALID_INPUT`         | 400         |
| `INVALID_STATE`         | 409         |
| `CONFLICT`              | 409         |
| `CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE`  | 409         |
| `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`        | 409         |
| `SPEND_LIMIT_REACHED`   | 402         |
| `UNSUPPORTED`           | 422         |
| `UPGRADE_REQUIRED`      | 426         |
| `RATE_LIMITED`          | 429         |
| `DRIVER_ERROR`          | 502         |
| `PROVIDER_ERROR`        | 502         |
| `INVALID_CONFIG`        | 500         |
| `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`       | 501         |
| `CSRF_REJECTED`         | 403         |
| `UNTRUSTED_ORIGIN`      | 403         |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`    | 405         |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`     | 413         |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR`        | 500         |
| `MISSING_DEPENDENCY`    | 500         |
| `CONFIG_DRIFT`          | 409         |
| `UNAVAILABLE`           | 503         |
